title: All eyes on Rubio as Iran, Ukraine set to dominate G7 meeting in Paris
summary: G7 foreign ministers began two days of talks in Paris on Monday as they grapple with multiple unresolved global crises. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is likely to face questions about whether the Trump administration will shift its positions on the conflicts in Ukraine and Iran in particular following the Democrats sweeping victory in the midterms.
